question: The Women, Business and the Law Index 2025 is published by which international institution ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Women, Business and the Law Index** is an initiative of the **World Bank**, aimed at measuring gender equality in terms of laws and regulations impacting women's economic participation.
 
• This index tracks the progress of **190 economies** globally and evaluates them based on **eight indicators**, including mobility, workplace, pay, marriage, parenthood, entrepreneurship, assets, and pension.
 
• The 2025 edition of the **Women, Business and the Law Index** will continue to assess how laws and policies either support or hinder women's economic opportunities worldwide.
 
• The World Bank launched this initiative to help policymakers identify barriers to women's economic inclusion and work towards reforms that promote gender equality.
 
• This index provides a comprehensive overview of the legal framework
